name: 2 Peter
title: 2 Peter — True Knowledge vs Mockers
tagline: Grow in grace; the Day will come like a thief.

author.traditional: Peter (authorship debated critically; received as Petrine in the canon we hold).

purpose: Recall true apostolic word; warn of sensual heresy; affirm Parousia.
christ: Beloved Son on the holy mountain; coming Judge and Savior.
spirit: Men spoke from God as carried along by the Spirit (1:21).
jesus_in_this_book: Beloved Son on the holy mountain; coming Judge and Savior.
how_to_read: Pair with Jude. Take false teachers seriously.
watchman_charge: Make your calling sure. Do not follow mockers. Hasten the day by holy lives.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
